g.text: Same four experiments; percentages and success counts are shown separately for the two measurements.

text.style: font-weight: 700; font-size: 12px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #233643

g.text: The timeout/dropout run did have rare FRONT and RIGHT successes during training.

text.style: font-size: 10.5px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #536a78

g.text: FRONT: 1/1,757 (0.057%). RIGHT: 1/1,775 (0.056%). Neither succeeded in its deterministic evaluation cases.

text.style: font-size: 10px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #536a78

g.text: Evaluation uses monitoring seeds 10000–10099. The interrupted run's latest recorded evaluation is at 1.25M steps.

text.style: font-size: 10px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #536a78

g.text: Training pools sampled-action episodes across learning; it does not measure the final policy. Budgets and initialization differ.

text.style: font-size: 10px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #536a78

g.text: Other 57-input timeout/dropout variants reached 4/22 RIGHT evaluation successes (18.2%); their FRONT evaluation remained 0/18.

text.style: font-size: 10px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #536a78

g.text: At matched 1.5M steps, both route variants evaluated at LEFT/RIGHT/BACK 100% and FRONT 77.8%; collisions were 0 vs 4/100.
